header.running_head: The Importance Rasulullaah ﷺ Attached to the Emphasised Sunnah Salaahs

blocks.text: Aa'isha (RA) about the optional salaahs that Rasulullaah ﷺ performed. She replied, "Rasulullaah ﷺ would perform four Rakaahs at home before the Zuhr salaah. He would then leave for the Masjid to lead the people in salaah. Thereafter, he would return to my room and perform two Rakaahs. After leading the people in Maghrib salaah, he would return to my room and perform two Rakaahs. Afterwards, he would lead the people in Isha and then return to perform two Rakaahs in my room. At night, he would perform nine Rakaahs salaah including the Witr. At times he would perform salaah for long time standing while at other times, he would perform salaah for a long time sitting. When performing salaah standing, he would perform Ruku and Sajdah from a standing position and when performing salaah sitting, he would perform Ruku and Sajdah from a sitting position. Then when dawn broke, he would perform two Rakaahs before leaving for the Masjid to lead the people in the Fajr salaah." [^1]
The Extreme Importance Rasulullaah ﷺ gave to the Two Rakaahs Before the Fajr Salaah

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) says, "Rasulullaah ﷺ did not attach as much importance to any optional salaahs as much as he attached to the two Rakaahs of Fajr." [^2] In another narration, Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) states, "I have not seen Rasulullaah ﷺ so eager to do any good deed as much as he was to perform the two Rakaahs before Fajr. In fact, he was not even that eager for booty." [^3]
Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) also mentioned that Rasulullaah ﷺ would never omit the four Rakaahs before Zuhr salaah and the two Rakaahs before Fajr. [^4]

Hadhrat Bilaal (RA) reports that he once went to inform Rasulullaah ﷺ that the time for Fajr had arrived. Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) occupied Hadhrat Bilaal (RA) by asking him about something until the sky had started to get very bright. Hadhrat Bilaal (RA) then started to call Rasulullaah ﷺ several times, but Rasulullaah ﷺ did not come out. After a while, Rasulullaah ﷺ came out and after leading the salaah, Hadhrat Bilaal (RA) informed him that Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) had occupied him by asking him about something and that (despite him calling) Rasulullaah ﷺ had delayed in coming out. Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "(I was delayed because) I had been performing the two Rakaahs of Fajr." "O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" Hadhrat Bilaal (RA) asked, "(Why did you not leave it out because) The sky had already become very bright?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "Even if the sky had become brighter than that, I would have still performed it and performed it well and properly." [^5]
Muslim, as quoted in Safwatus Safwah (Vol.1 Pg.75). Abu Dawood and Tirmidhi have also reported the narration, as quoted in Jam'ul Fawaa'id (Vol.1 Pg.110).
Ibn Khuzaymah, as quoted in Targheeb wat Tarheeb (Vol.1 Pg.361).
Abu Dawood (Vol.2 Pg.259), reporting from reliable sources as confirmed by Nawawi in Riyaadhus Saaliheen (Pg.416)
